item.title: API Management Requests Workbook
item.description: Finding specific API Management requests in Application Insights means re-adding the same filters every time and the results lack API Management specific data. In this post, I walk through an Azure Workbook that can filter on status, subscription, API, operation and result code, and shows a graph over time and a table with the matching requests.

item.title: Logic App Workflow Runs Workbook
item.description: The Insights screen of a Logic App shows workflow runs, but only for a single Logic App and with some limitations. In this post, I walk through an Azure Workbook that shows the runs of multiple Logic Apps in one place, including cancelled runs, a graph over time, trace links and the option to view or resubmit a run.

item.title: Monitoring Azure Integrations with a Dashboard
item.description: Integrations built with Azure Integration Services can include components from several services, each with its own monitoring experience. In this post, I show how I bring API Management requests, Azure Functions, Logic App workflows and Service Bus signals together in an Azure dashboard, then turn that dashboard into a reusable Bicep deployment.
